title: How did data sharing evolve in the decade since the FAIR Principles?
abstract: arXiv:2611.20319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A decade after the publication of the FAIR Guiding Principles, what have we learned about data sharing, and what do data availability statements (DAS) and other materials accrued over that period tell us about how data-sharing practices, attitudes, and infrastructures evolved? Here, we present a large-scale longitudinal analysis of over 6.8 million biomedical articles from the PMC Open Access Subset, spanning 2011 to 2025. Using an automated pipeline, we extracted and classified DAS, repository links, accession numbers, and supplementary materials, assigning each article a data-sharing score and independently FAIR-assessing a subset of cited dataset URLs. We find that explicit DAS adoption rose from ~2% in 2011 to 68% in 2025, while "available on request" statements grew in parallel from near zero to over 19%. translated_title: 自FAIR原则发布以来的十年间，数据共享是如何演变的？
translated_abstract: 在FAIR指导原则发表十年之后，我们对数据共享有了哪些了解？这段时期积累的数据可用性声明（DAS）及其他材料，能告诉我们数据共享的实践、态度和基础设施是如何演变的？在此，我们对来自PMC开放获取子集的超过680万篇生物医学文章进行了大规模纵向分析，时间跨度为2011年至2025年。我们利用自动化流程提取并分类了DAS、存储库链接、登录号和补充材料，为每篇文章分配了数据共享评分，并对部分被引用的数据集URL独立开展了FAIR评估。我们发现，明确DAS的采用率从2011年的约2%上升到2025年的68%，而“可按请求提供”类声明的比例也同步从接近零增长到超过19%。语料库的增长进一步放大了这两种趋势：包含明确存储库提及的DAS文章从2011年的132篇上升到（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究对2011至2025年间680余万篇生物医学开放获取论文进行了大规模纵向分析，发现明确数据可用性声明的采用率从约2%升至68%，揭示了FAIR原则发布十年间数据共享实践的显著演进。
en_tdlr: This study presents a large-scale longitudinal analysis of over 6.8 million biomedical open-access articles from 2011 to 2025, showing that explicit data availability statement adoption rose from ~2% to 68%, revealing the significant evolution of data-sharing practices in the decade since the FAIR Principles.
